'''Antonio''' (Japanese: '''アントーニオ''' ''Antonio'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}.

==History==
Antonio debuted in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where he participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament. His first opponent was [[Emmanuel]], who he was able to defeat using his {{p|Tranquill}}, thus advancing him to the second round. In ''[[BW041|The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!]]'', he was defeated by [[Dino]] in the quarterfinals.

In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Antonio competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning he had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', he appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, meaning he had made it through the second and third rounds.

In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', it was revealed he had made it through the fourth round as well. In the quarterfinals, he battled [[Ramone]] and lost, placing him in the Top 8. Afterwards, he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.
